title: GreenGateway Deployment Configuration
description: The deployment document of a greengateway.dev/v1alpha1 configuration bundle, generated from the configuration field catalog. Each setting under spec is one catalog field at its document path, typed and bounded as the catalog says, and every object is closed. Integers lie within the I-JSON safe range, a fractional setting is a decimal string, a setting whose value may carry a secret accepts only a secretReference, and no setting accepts an unresolved placeholder. A setting that holds a JSON document in environment mode is an array of closed objects mirroring the compiler's own types, in which every member that may carry a secret is a secretReference and host paths and literal request headers have no form. A decimal setting's bounds are stated in its description and enforced by the reader. No gateway starts from a deployment document yet. This schema is necessary but not sufficient: the gateway's reader is authoritative, and rules that relate settings are the configuration compiler's.

apiVersion.description: Exact document version. No other version, prefix, or spelling is accepted.

spec.description: The deployment profile and the deployment settings.

profile.description: The deployment profile. Its invariants are enforced by the configuration compiler, not by this schema.

listeners.description: The listeners the gateway binds. Certificate, key, CA and CRL files are host locators and stay in the environment; the document states whether each listener terminates TLS and checks a revocation list.

tls.description: Whether the data listener terminates TLS. The certificate and key are host locators that stay in the environment; the compiler will hold this intent and them to each other.

client_certificate_crl.description: Whether the data listener checks client certificates against a certificate revocation list. The list is a host locator that stays in the environment; the compiler will hold this intent and it to each other.

admin.description: The admin surface: its own listener, when it has one, and its path prefix.

client_certificate_crl.description: Whether the admin listener checks client certificates against a certificate revocation list. The list is a host locator that stays in the environment; the compiler will hold this intent and it to each other.

secretReference.description: An opaque secret alias ID resolved by the gateway's secret providers. It is never a secret value, an environment-variable name, a file path, a provider locator, or ciphertext.

unresolved.description: A placeholder an export, conversion, or template writes where it could not or would not supply a value. No setting accepts one, so a document that contains one never validates.

decimal.description: A fractional setting written as a string; JSON numbers in bundle documents are integers only. The canonical form is the shortest exact spelling.

text.description: A non-empty string with no whitespace at either end. Its own grammar is the configuration compiler's.

list.description: The entries of an environment variable's comma-separated list: non-empty strings with no comma and no whitespace at either end.

authProvider.description: One authentication provider, an AUTH_PROVIDERS entry. client_id, client_secret and redirect_uri, which only the admin login provider reads, are set under spec.admin_login.

upstreamRoute.description: One upstream route, an UPSTREAM_ROUTES entry.

add_request_headers.description: Static request headers can carry a credential, so this document version cannot hold their values; use a managed Connection. Only an empty object is accepted.
